target.title: fix(firecracker): guard Cleanup claim removal against a concurrent reclaim
target.body:
`(*backend).Cleanup` decides via `shouldCleanupRecord`, releases the VM, then calls the **unguarded** `core.RemoveLeaseClaim`. A concurrent `Resolve`/`Touch` that reclaims the same lease inside that check→destroy window has its freshly-rewritten claim deleted out from under the live session. Trigger is two concurrent runs; no attacker. Same `[security]` class as https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/446.

**Fix:** guard both removals with `core.RemoveLeaseClaimIfUnchanged` against the pre-cleanup snapshot (mirrors `namespaceinstance` backend.go:455,473).

**Verify:** `go test ./internal/providers/firecracker/ -run TestCleanupTOCTOU -race` — `TestCleanupTOCTOUDeletesConcurrentlyReclaimedClaim` fails on base, passes with this fix. `go vet ./... && go build ./cmd/crabbox`.

Part of https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/1123.

target.title: fix(blacksmith): don't stop a concurrently-claimed testbox in failed-warmup cleanup
target.body:
`cleanupFailedWarmup` sweeps any testbox that matches the config (repo/workflow/job/ref) and is absent from a pre-warmup snapshot. A testbox created concurrently by another crabbox process with the same config appears after the snapshot, matches the config-only matcher, and is stopped — severing that process's healthy, in-use lease. No per-invocation ownership marker. Trigger is two concurrent runs. Same `[security]` class as https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/446.

**Fix:** skip sweep candidates carrying a live lease claim (`core.ResolveLeaseClaimForProvider`). A successful warmup registers a claim; our own failed warmup never claims, so a genuine orphan stays unclaimed and is still swept, while a concurrently-claimed box is left intact.

**Verify:** `go test ./internal/providers/blacksmith/ -run TestCrossProcCleanupFailedWarmup -race` — `TestCrossProcCleanupFailedWarmupStopsConcurrentProcessTestbox` fails on base, passes with this fix. `go vet ./... && go build ./cmd/crabbox`.

Part of https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/1123.
